title: EnvironmentState
description: The Magnetic Vector Field state defining the attractors and system pressure for Weightless Control.

magnetic_fields.description: The current semantic attractors. Keys are node/skill IDs, values are the gravitational pull (0.0 to 1.0).

entropy_level.description: The current thermodynamic noise level (0.0 to 1.0) applied to break metastable equilibrium.

system_pressure.description: Global urgency multiplier. 1.0 is normal, 2.0 indicates critical priority affecting Puck momentum.

constraints.description: Active global constraints acting as repulsors (negative gravity).
